title: Restore orb dome liquid: guard mask flood from carving the top cap
head: fix/orbs-dome-cap-mask
body:
The v3 mask flood walked down the static plate's milky dome highlight on the life orb and carved the upper dome interior (rr 0.80-1.0), so the liquid vanished below the rim and the pale static glass showed over the fill.

- fix_mask.py: top-cap guard (no interior carving above p.y 0.75); idempotent from new pristine mask_baseline.png
- mask.png regenerated: dome dynamic to the rim, statue carves intact
- Headless pixel-verified vs the June original: dome scanline matches within +/-2/channel
- wizard-lab verify: PASS
